title.narrative: HPN - Cluster 6: FP/RMNCAH and Nutrition in Turkana

description.narrative: (Kenya): Using FY 2022 funds, USAID will support the Imarisha Jamii activity to increase the use of quality county-led health services in Turkana County through a service delivery systems approach. The county is currently intensely affected by one the worst droughts experienced in the region in 40 years and is in dire need of humanitarian assistance in addition to outreach focused and integrated health services to meet the needs of the mobile pastoralist populations as they search for food and pasture for what is left of their animals.The activity will utilize innovative context-specific strategies to increase the knowledge of and demand for essential services and multi-sectoral approaches to achieve results within an integrated activity. USAID investments will strengthen health systems and build local capacity and resilience for maternal, adolescent,newborn, child health and nutrition (RMNCAH) and nutrition. Specifically, the activity will strengthen health systems by:Building the capacity of county and sub-county health managers on leadership, management, accountability and governance.Creating awareness within counties on domestic resource mobilization approaches and ring fencing of health budgets, so as to increase and secure health related budgets.Improving access to antenatal care and skilled birth attendance through advancing universal health coverage by increasing the number of health facilities enrolled in Linda Mama/Free Maternity Services rolled out by the National Health Insurance Fund among rural populations.Improving health information systems to provide quality and timely data in District Health Information Software 2 (DHIS2).Supporting counties in building strong integrated commodity supply systems at facility, sub- county and county levels..$200,000 of the $1,000,000 will be used to meet the "micronutrients" earmark under this activity..
